name: AWS End User Messaging
description: Send OTP codes by SMS through AWS End User Messaging Notify, using AWS-managed numbers and preapproved templates.

fields.name: awsRegion
fields.description: The AWS region the Notify configuration is in.

fields.name: authType
fields.description: How to authenticate with AWS: using static credentials or by assuming an IAM role.

fields.name: accessKeyId
fields.description: The AWS access key ID. Required when the authentication type is 'credentials'.

fields.name: secretAccessKey
fields.description: The AWS secret access key. Required when the authentication type is 'credentials'.

fields.name: roleArn
fields.description: The ARN of the IAM role to assume. Required when the authentication type is 'assumeRole'.

fields.name: externalId
fields.description: The external ID used when assuming the IAM role. Required when the authentication type is 'assumeRole'.

fields.name: notifyConfigurationId
fields.description: The ID of the AWS End User Messaging Notify configuration that sends the messages.

fields.name: defaultTemplateId
fields.description: The Notify template used when the flow does not select one. Leave empty to use the Notify configuration's default template.

fields.name: templateCodeVariable
fields.description: The template variable that receives the OTP code. Defaults to 'code'.

fields.name: templateExpiryMinutes
fields.description: The code expiry in minutes, between 1 and 60. Set it when the template shows the code's expiry, and leave it at 0 when it doesn't, since AWS rejects the message otherwise.

fields.name: configurationSetName
fields.description: The AWS configuration set whose event destinations receive delivery events, including messages that AWS blocks.
